svg/: 25 byte-for-byte upstream sources. themes/: custom derivatives modified 2026-09-30 by P4Desk asset adaptation. Explicit light/dark palettes, retained vector gradients, 64x64 normalization and inner rounded border. 23 black raster shadows and one blue folder raster glow removed; blur filters removed, local vector geometry retained. Three symbolic icons plus two unplated device icons receive gradient rounded plates. Monitor waveform and USB label enhanced; two irrelevant timer remnants hidden.

These are custom derivatives, not official upstream independent Light/Dark app variants. Source archive extraction preserved regular files and skipped symlinks; selected originals are all regular files. Upstream install.sh inspected, not executed.
